recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If literal wildcard inputs such as image/* or */* should become normative syntax in addition to contenttype:below=image, that should be handled as a new search-semantics decision rather than a missing FHIR-17742 application.
issue_request: FHIR-17742 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search issue raised against STU3 and applied for R5. It requested MIME/content-type search behavior for top-level media types and subtypes, originally described as [type]/* and */*. The accepted resolution specified adding this to :below by searching on just the media-type segment, for example /DocumentReference?contenttype:below=image selecting image/gif and image/jpeg regardless of MIME parameters.
initial_application: The MIME :below guidance originated in git-svn commit 466c4233f3dce83b7ebe6c63305f9161dada150f for GF#16970. FHIR-17742 was explicitly applied by bb804361418ab15066908540b1e4639e5f068288 on 2022-08-25, adding the first-segment contenttype:below=image example to source/search.html.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists search.html as the active RESTful API Search page. The current source/search.html section still documents DocumentReference.contenttype, :below=text/xml handling of MIME parameters, and :below=image matching all image/ content types. A FHIR-16970 audit already on the combined branch confirms the same MIME search section remains current, and corrected Zulip/Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting records.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source already conveys the accepted resolution semantics; the Jira summary's wildcard phrasing was superseded by the voted resolution's bare media-type segment example.
